subject: Arkadia performance rebid + proposed term / capacity offer
messages:
From: Lila Gomez <lila.gomez@arkadia.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Rebid request — performance numbers vs competitor

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from Arkadia: we just completed an internal bakeoff and the procurement team has surfaced BlueHorizon as a possible replacement. Their engineering team gave us p95 figures that are ~30% lower than the numbers we see on Redwood for our current workload, and their commercial was ~20% below our renewal line item once we include the committed capacity they proposed.

We're still evaluating, but before procurement pushes this further we need three things from Redwood:
- a public benchmark (or run with our workload) showing p50/p95/p99 for our <seq- and token-distribution>
- a clear proposal for a 12–18 month term with dedicated capacity options and incremental pricing at 2x/3x volume tiers
- a migration/upgrade credit or other concession to offset migration cost if we move forward with a longer term now

I'm looping procurement shortly (cc below) but wanted to start with you since you'll know the best path for a head-to-head. I've attached the BlueHorizon side-by-side we received (filename: bluehorizon-comparison.pdf).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can run a live replay with our payloads, and what a provisional commercial offer would look like?

Thanks,
Lila
Lila Gomez
Head of Platform
Arkadia Inc


From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lila Gomez <lila.gomez@arkadia.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rebid request — performance numbers vs competitor

Lila — thanks for the context and the attachment. We take these rebids seriously and want to make this as straightforward as possible. Proposed next steps:

1) Benchmark window: we can run a 2-hour live replay against your production-style payloads (no real customer PII needed) on our staging cluster w/ KV cache warmup.
2) Technical ask: Rohan (SE) below will outline payload/traffic requirements we need.
3) Commercial: Dev (pricing) will draft a provisional term + uplift/credit structure we can present to your procurement.

Please confirm a 2-hour slot you prefer (we have Jan 24, Jan 25 mornings available PST). If you want dedicated capacity measurements, we can reserve a small dedicated pool for the test window (chargeable, but adjustable into the committed terms if you move forward).

I attached a short runbook (redwood-bench-plan.md) that walks through what we'll measure and how we report.

I'll own coordination — once we have the replay results we'll include a proposed 12/18-month term with explicit volume tiers and a migration credit recommendation for exec review.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Lila Gomez <lila.gomez@arkadia.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rebid request — performance numbers vs competitor

Hi Lila / Evelyn —

Happy to run the replay. To make the results actionable, we need the following from Arkadia before the test:
- sample payload set (json or gz) representing ~10k requests; include token counts and sequence length distribution (mean/95th).
- expected QPS during the 2-hour test (burst and steady-state), and any peak-sim patterns (e.g., 3x bursts every 15m).
- the model variant you currently run (or the open model we should evaluate). If you'd like, we can test two variants: a throughput-optimized quantized variant and a latency-optimized fp16 variant.
- SLA target for p95 that you need to defend vs procurement

We'll run: cold-run, warmed-KV-run, and a continuous-batch run. Metrics we will capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and cost per 1M tokens under the same batching config.

Attached: benchmark-script.sh (stub) and a short checklist. I can run the test on Jan 24 at 09:00 PST if that works.

-Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jan 18, 2027 at 09:45, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Lila — thanks for the context...
From: Lila Gomez <lila.gomez@arkadia.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@arkadia.com>, procurement@arkadia.com
Date: 2027-01-18T12:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rebid request — performance numbers vs competitor

Evelyn / Rohan — thanks for the quick reply. We can provide sample payloads via shared Drive (https://drive.google.com/arkadia/sample-payloads) — majority of requests are 40–120 tokens, ~3% long tail at 800–1200 tokens. Typical steady QPS ~18, peak burst to 75 for 3–5 minutes.

Model: currently using a 13B open variant. Target p95 we'd like to hit is 180ms or lower for our typical request shape — that's the number folks at BlueHorizon are citing.

Jan 24 09:00 PST works for the 2-hour run. One commercial clarification: procurement needs to see what a committed capacity price would look like at 2x/3x current usage, and whether any migration credit is available if we sign a 12–18 month term. I added Carlos (CFO) to the thread to keep finance in the loop.

Lila
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lila Gomez <lila.gomez@arkadia.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rebid request — performance numbers vs competitor (provisional commercial)

Lila — following up with a provisional commercial outline we can present after the Jan 24 benchmark. High level proposal (provisional):

- Term options: 12 months or 18 months.
- Pricing: 10% off list for 12m, 14% off list for 18m (volume tiers apply).
- Volume tiers: baseline, 2x baseline, 3x baseline with incremental discounts at +3% and +5% respectively.
- Migration credit: $15,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice if signing within 30 days of benchmark results.
- Dedicated burst: reserved pool available for test and optionally folded into committed pool for conversion credits.

I attached a draft term sheet (term-sheet-draft.pdf). If Arkadia accepts the provisional structure we will escalate a final concession approval for executive sign-off. Marissa — can you confirm if $15k + the 14% (18m) is approvable or if we need a separate exec exception?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Director, Pricing & Commercials | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lila Gomez <lila.gomez@arkadia.com>, Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@arkadia.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rebid request — performance numbers vs competitor (approval)

Dev / Evelyn — approved. We can greenlight the $15k migration credit and firm up to 15% off list for an 18-month signed commitment if Arkadia signs by Jan 31. Condition: include an SLA uplift clause (p95 remedy ladder) and a commitment to a joint migration plan (Redwood + Arkadia engineering owners).

Evelyn — please prepare the final term sheet and send via DocuSign; include the benchmark results as an exhibit to the term sheet. I'll also add a note in the deal record for a potential extra executive concession if Arkadia pushes for additional credits.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
